purpose: Prospectively frozen transport assessment of the existing manual T-end review aid and its retrospectively selected agreement strata; no automatic QT promotion.

cohort.selectionRule: Rank IDs 1..200 excluding previously observed records and the calibration cohort by SHA256(seed + colon + decimal ID); take first 40, then sort numerically.
cohort.role: Previously reserved same-dataset cohort; becomes exposed when this protocol first evaluates it.

productInput: Only fs and leads; annotations are available solely to the evaluator.

reference.eventAggregation: Lead II anchors each P, QRS or T event; nearest unused same-wave event in I/V1/V5 within 150 ms completes a four-lead group. Incomplete groups are reported, never imputed.
reference.onsetAggregation: Earliest onset across all four matched leads, only when all four source onsets exist.
reference.peakAggregation: Median peak across all four matched leads.
reference.offsetAggregation: Latest offset across all four matched leads, only when all four source offsets exist.
reference.intervalAssociation: Descriptive engineering association only: for each aggregate QRS, use the latest P peak 20-450 ms before QRS and the earliest T peak 40-800 ms after QRS, with T required before the next QRS minus 20 ms. No diagnosis or rhythm label is used.

evaluation.primary: T-offset error of high-agreement proposals, reporting all proposals, missing/unmatched endpoints and coverage against every eligible reference.
secondary: QT association remains descriptive; T-offset performance alone is not QT validation

Hypothetical review QT = existing detected QRS onset to proposed T end, paired by QRS and T event against the frozen descriptive reference; errors reported, never a product value or clinical QT acceptance gate
evaluation.statistics: Signed bias, absolute MAE, ordinary median, nearest-rank p95, maximum; report pooled beats and equal-weight record MAE separately.
evaluation.uncertainty: Record-level bootstrap of pooled high-agreement MAE, 2000 draws, seed 20261007, percentile 95% interval; exploratory precision description, no diagnostic-confidence interpretation.
evaluation.criterionRationale: Error bounds carried forward unchanged from retrospective development. Fewer than ten contributing records gives insufficient evidence regardless of pooled errors; this is an engineering sufficiency rule, not a clinical sample-size calculation.

outcomePolicy: Publish all outcomes including failure/inconclusive, keep manual review and every lower-agreement proposal. Integrity gates fail on corrupt input or protocol drift; unfavorable scientific outcomes are reported and cannot be fixed by tuning on this cohort.
limitations: Same-dataset reserved validation is not independent external validation.
Four-lead aggregate is not an original global LUDB annotation.
Ten-second records and correlated beats limit inference.
Historical holdoutEnabled=false continues to describe older calibration workflows; this separate protocol is the explicit first-use authorization.
